assay: bulk RNA-seq (polyA, Illumina NovaSeq 6000 PE150) of gastrocnemius from aged male C57BL/6JRj mice (S2.8.p1, S4.11.p1)
sample_inclusion: 12 mice randomized at 17 months to rosiglitazone diet (0.6 mg/kg/d in AIN-93M, n=6) or plain AIN-93M control diet (n=6) (S4.6.p1; FIG5 C n=6 per group). WGCNA used 5 rosiglitazone + 6 control (FIG5 D, Fig. S3).
primary_estimand: Effect of dietary rosiglitazone vs control diet on gastrocnemius gene expression in aged mice. No exercise intervention exists: treadmill (S4.7.p1), rotarod (S4.8.p1) and grip tests (S4.9.p1) are phenotyping assays applied to both groups, not a training arm.
planned_contrasts: rosiglitazone vs control (S2.8.p1; paper: 383 up + 100 down = 483 DEGs)
normalization: DESeq2 size factors; pre-filter genes with >1 count per sample and total >12 (S4.13.p1)
paper_results: 383 up / 100 down DEGs; Igf1 up; Foxo4, Fbxo32, Trim63 down; fgsea PI3K-Akt up NES 1.68 (S2.8.p1)
